preconditions.description: The number of integers N in the sequence is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= B[i][j] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix B is between 0 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N for _ in range(Q) for p in [int(input().strip())])
preconditions.description: Each row/column index p in the queries is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= F[i] <= 5000 for i in range(N)) for _ in range(Q) for F in [list(map(int, input().strip().split()))])
preconditions.description: Each element in the new row/column values F is between 0 and 5000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(sequence) == N for sequence in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each line contains N space-separated integers.
The first element of the initial sequence is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(all(abs(return_value[i][j] - return_value[i][k]) == B[i][k] for k in range(N)) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: The absolute differences between elements in the sequence match the initial matrix B.

postconditions.expression:
all(all(abs(return_value[i+1][j] - return_value[i+1][k]) == B[i+1][k] for k in range(N)) for i in range(Q) for j in range(N) for B in [list(map(lambda x: list(map(int, x.strip().split())), input().strip().split('
')[1:N+1])) for _ in range(Q+1)])
postconditions.description: The absolute differences between elements in the sequence match the matrix B after each query.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == sorted(return_value[i]) for i in range(Q + 1))
postconditions.description: Each sequence is the lexicographically smallest possible sequence.
